title: Vernon Private Wine & Boat Tour on Okanagan Lake
includes: Private wine guide and boat captain
Pick up and drop off at the hotel or address indicated in your booking
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Experience the Okanagan like never before with this full-sensory private tour that combines the best of land and lake. Taste world-class wines, enjoy a leisurely vineyard lunch, and unwind aboard a captained pontoon boat cruise across the stunning waters of Okanagan Lake.

This 7-hour private journey begins and ends at your hotel in Vernon and features three winery visits with complimentary tastings, a scenic lunch break, and a relaxing two-hour boat cruise. It’s the perfect mix of elegance and adventure for wine lovers and explorers alike.
